critical_issues.msg: `update_customer` sets attributes via `setattr` without a `tenant_id` guard on the UPDATE itself — after the `get_customer` lookup the subsequent ops are not tenant-scoped.
critical_issues.suggestion: Add `customer.tenant_id == tenant_id` as a safety assertion after the lookup: `assert customer.tenant_id == tenant_id, 'Tenant mismatch'` or re-fetch with a filtered query inside a transaction.

critical_issues.msg: `mock_session` fixture does not mock `execute`, yet every service method calls `session.execute()` — tests pass only because assertions never touch the result of `execute`.
critical_issues.suggestion: Add `execute = AsyncMock()` to the fixture body so that any test that inspects the result of `execute` will work correctly.

suggestions.msg: `__post_init__` re-assigns values already established by dataclass field defaults (`id=None`, `phone=None`, `company=None`, `tags=[]`), making `if self.id is None: self.id = None` a pure no-op.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the redundant assignments. Keep only the `status` and datetime checks if they guard against None coming from `from_dict`.

suggestions.msg: `tags` is in `CustomerModel` but absent from the `allowed` set, so tag updates via `update_customer` are silently dropped.

`VALID_STATUSES` is missing `"opportunity"` which is defined in `CustomerStatus` enum (line 13 of models/customer.py); passing `"opportunity"` to `update_customer` or `change_status` raises `ValidationException`.
`create_customer` calls `session.commit()` directly; callers cannot roll back on failure.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the commit from the service; let the router/transaction manager call commit after all services in a unit-of-work complete.

suggestions.msg: Variable `result` is assigned but never used; the test only asserts on mock call counts, not on the actual returned `CustomerModel`.
suggestions.suggestion: Assert on the returned object: `assert result.name == 'Test'`.

suggestions.msg: No test covers the error path when `update_customer` or `change_status` receives an invalid status value (the `ValidationException` code path).
suggestions.suggestion: Add `pytest.mark.asyncio async def test_update_customer_invalid_status(mock_session): ...` that passes an unknown status and asserts `pytest.raises(ValidationException)`.
Add tests for at least `update_customer` and `delete_customer` paths including the not-found and validation cases.
